prompt.text: A bean plant needs nutrients and water, grows and changes, and can make new plants of its kind. What do these clues show?

options.label: They are needs and characteristics of living things
They show that the plant is a non-living object
They are all types of weather
They describe only things made by machines

feedback.correct: Correct. Living things need resources, grow and change, and reproduce.
feedback.incorrect: Use all four clues together: nutrients, water, growth and making new living things.

authoring.scopeNote: Integrated review of four canonical Class 3 living-things rows; avoids forcing repeated-subject facts into indistinguishable card choices.
